The '''''Xim's Scion''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] destroyed in a skirmish with the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A group of enterprising [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] towed the forward 250-meter portion of the cruiser into an elliptical orbit around [[Gus Treta/Legends|Gus Treta]], and converted into a [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station|refueling depot and market]] over the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
